summary_en: TAKAOKA TOKO set October 8, 2026 as the cancellation date for 657,000 treasury shares acquired under the April 28, 2026 board resolution, reducing outstanding shares to 15,619,305.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Scheduled Cancellation Date of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: On September 30, 2026, TAKAOKA TOKO announced the scheduled cancellation date for treasury shares. The company will cancel 657,000 ordinary shares on October 8, 2026, representing 4.2% of outstanding shares (calculated as 657,000 divided by 15,619,305+657,000). These shares were acquired under the board resolution of April 28, 2026. Upon cancellation, the total number of outstanding shares will be 15,619,305.
